description: Replace one connector by its id. This replaces the connector rather than patching it, so send the full definition you want it to end up with - read mba_get_connector first.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

auth_config.description: Credentials matching auth_type: `api_key` when auth_type is API_KEY, `oauth2_client_credentials` when it is OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS. Credentials can also be set later with upsert_connector_api_key or upsert_connector_oauth.

api_key.description: Where the API key is injected. Supply at least one of headers, query_params, body_params.

field_name.description: Header, query or body field name.
Header, query or body field name.
Header, query or body field name.

base_url.description: Base URL every tool on this connector calls.

requires_certificate.description: True when the system needs mTLS; upload the certificate with upsert_connector_certificate.

user_auth_injection_config.description: Optional configuration for injecting a per-user token into tool requests.

name: mba_update_connector

api_key.description: API key configuration. Provide only when auth_type is API_KEY.

body_params.description: API key fields to add as JSON body parameters

field_name.description: Header, query parameter, or body field name

prefix.description: Optional value prefix, such as Bearer followed by a space

value.description: Secret value for this API key field

headers.description: API key fields to add as HTTP headers

field_name.description: Header, query parameter, or body field name

prefix.description: Optional value prefix, such as Bearer followed by a space

value.description: Secret value for this API key field

query_params.description: API key fields to add as query parameters

field_name.description: Header, query parameter, or body field name

prefix.description: Optional value prefix, such as Bearer followed by a space

value.description: Secret value for this API key field

oauth2_client_credentials.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials configuration. Provide only when auth_type is OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS.

token_request_content_type.description: Content type for token requests. Supports application/x-www-form-urlencoded and application/json. Defaults to application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

token_url.description: Token URL used to request OAuth access tokens

auth_type.description: Authentication type for this connector. Known values: OAUTH2, OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS, API_KEY, BASIC, CUSTOM, NONE.

base_url.description: Base URL of the external API

status.description: Current connection status. Known values: PENDING_OAUTH, ACTIVE, EXPIRED, ERROR.

connector_protocol.description: Protocol used by this connector. Defaults to HTTP when omitted. Known values: HTTP, MCP.

id.description: The unique identifier for this connector

mcp_tool_sync.description: MCP tool discovery cache status. Null for HTTP connectors.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the cached remote tool set

last_attempted_at.description: Unix timestamp of the latest refresh attempt

last_successful_at.description: Unix timestamp of the latest successful refresh

status.description: Current MCP tool refresh status. Known values: ERROR, PENDING, READY.

tool_count.description: Number of cached remote MCP tools

mtls_config.description: mTLS certificate metadata and PEM content (private key is never exposed)

ca_certificate.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate chain (public, safe to expose)

client_certificate.description: PEM-encoded client certificate (public, safe to expose)

has_certificate.description: Whether an mTLS certificate is configured

user_auth_injection_config.description: Configuration for injecting user auth tokens into tool requests

field_name.description: Field name for the injected token (e.g. X-User-Token)

location.description: Where to inject the token. Known values: body, headers, path, query.

prefix.description: Prefix for the token value (e.g. Bearer )
